title: Jump at Camp
skill_description: Practice reading words with final consonant blends (-nd, -mp, -st, -nt, -nk) and doubled consonants (ff, ll, ss, zz).
author: FunBookies
summary: Jill and Jeff go to camp where they jump, stomp, and have fun until a wasp makes them run for help.

pages.scene: Two happy kids jumping in the air at a summer camp with tents in background. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Jill and Jeff went to camp. It was the best!
pages.scene: Two excited kids arriving at a summer camp with colorful tents. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: We must set up the tent. Help me, Jeff!
pages.scene: Two kids working together to set up a tent. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: The tent fell! We must lift it fast.
pages.scene: A collapsed tent with two kids scrambling to fix it. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Jill and Jeff went to the sand. Jump! Jump!
pages.scene: Two kids jumping in sandy area at camp. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Stomp in the sand! Bump and jump!
pages.scene: Kids stomping and jumping in sand, having fun. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Buzz! Buzz! A wasp went past Jeff!
pages.scene: A wasp flying near a startled boy at camp. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Jeff ran fast! He went up the hill.
pages.scene: A boy running up a grassy hill away from a wasp. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Jill ran to help. She was fast!
pages.scene: A girl running to help her friend on the hill. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: The wasp left! Jeff was well. Jill was glad.
pages.scene: The wasp flying away, two relieved kids on the hill. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: We went back to camp. It was soft in the tent.
pages.scene: Two kids relaxing inside their cozy tent. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: A bell went off! It was the mess bell.
pages.scene: Kids hearing a dinner bell at camp. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: We must run! We will not miss it!
pages.scene: Two kids running toward the camp mess hall. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Jeff and Jill sat and had a snack. Yum!
pages.scene: Two kids eating snacks at a camp picnic table. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Camp was the best! Jump, stomp, and fun!
pages.scene: Happy kids waving goodbye to camp at sunset. Warm watercolor style.
Jill and Jeff sitting by a campfire under stars. Warm watercolor style.
